metadata.method_name: sigfaith (repaired monotonicity signature: D_rule type namer + gold flagger)
metadata.description:
Naming FOL errors and flagging bad gold — repaired monotonicity-signature metric (iter-2, experiment 5).

METHOD (sigfaith/): the iter-1 Arm-A signature (A3) with three screen-only repairs, then froze...

DIAGNOSER_POSITIVE.rule: D_rule top1 >= TJ-0.05 (CI lower) AND >= majority+0.15 AND recall>=0.6 on added/dropped/∀∃

BLIND_SPOTS_CONFIRMED.power_note: blind pool is small (n<~31); CI-overlap statement only, never a confirmation of ≈0.5

paired_Drule_minus_TJplus.note: TJ+ unparsed items (19/302 after one retry) count as 'none' (wrong)
TJ+ unparsed items (19/302 after one retry) count as 'none' (wrong)
TJ+ unparsed items (19/302 after one retry) count as 'none' (wrong)

ceiling.note: members' primary_error includes 'none' when a member judged the item faithful

reading.power_note: blind pool is small (n<~31); CI-overlap statement only, never a confirmation of ≈0.5

V3_screen_dev.note: DEV (screen golds were used for R2 silver); non-confirmatory

V6.note: no accuracy claim; grounded/ungrounded not split (out of scope)

frozen_config.text_side_rule: T0 rules marker (iter-1 A3); T1a/T1b/T1c/T2 as in sigfaith/core.choose_labels
frozen_config.score_weights: unchanged from iter-1 score.py: label 1/|aligned P|, dropped 1, added 1, swap 1, rel 0.5
frozen_config.coverage_rule: covered = parse_ok ∧ ≤20% '?' coords ∧ coverage ≥ 0.5 ∧ ≥1 labelled concept; else score 0.5

solver.heavy_fallback: N=2 if >12 predicates or >6 quantifiers; 120 s wall -> timeout (uncovered)

frozen_config.firewall_pre_freeze: closed (frozen_config.json does not exist: labels are locked until the freeze)
